description: This file defines the LogWrapper class that implements the LogNode interface. It wraps Android's native Log utility to allow for flexible logging by chaining LogNode objects.

classes.name: LogWrapper
classes.description: A helper class that wraps Android's native Log utility to facilitate flexible logging.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the linked list.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Logs a message with a specified priority, tag, and optional Throwable; passes the log to the next node if present.
